note: *nem eu me torne semelhante*, held against Latinist majors on both drafts: *assimilábor* is an affirmative future. Held by the *nequándo … et* row (2:12); his *não suceda que … e eu serei semelhante* is an option.
*pagai-lhes a retribuição deles*: the stylist found it bureaucratic and asked *retribuí-lhes a sua retribuição*, refused because *retribuí* is also "I repaid"; kept as an option.
*o meu auxílio e o meu protetor*, held against the Latinist's *auxiliador* (minor on draft 1, major at the gate). One of the eight *adjútor* places in HANDOFF (D19, D24).
